groups.title: Auth
groups.description: Wallet challenge, signature verification, and session lifecycle.

routes.description: Returns a one-time nonce string for the given wallet address. Sign it with the owner private key and submit to /verify.

agentMeta.note: Step 1 of owner auth. Call with the owner wallet address to receive a time-limited nonce. Sign it immediately with ECDSA (EIP-191) and pass to POST /auth/verify.

outputs.desc: Nonce string to sign with the owner private key

agentMeta.next: Sign the nonce and submit to POST /api/v1/auth/verify

errors.message: address query param is required
Not a valid 0x wallet address

routes.description: Submit the EIP-191 signed challenge. Gateway verifies the signature and returns a 24-hour JWT.

agentMeta.note: Step 2 of owner auth. Submit the signed challenge. On success the gateway returns a 24-hour JWT. Store it — all owner-side calls require it as the Bearer token.

outputs.desc: JWT — Authorization: Bearer <token> on all JWT-required endpoints

agentMeta.next: Store the JWT. Call GET /balance, POST /agent/credentials, or GET /services

errors.message: Signature does not match wallet address
Challenge expired — request a new one

routes.description: Returns the wallet-linked account profile: display name, email, and notification preferences.

agentMeta.note: Confirm authenticated identity. Use after auth to verify the JWT is valid and which wallet it is bound to.

errors.message: Missing or expired JWT

routes.description: Generates a one-time signing challenge for updating the account profile (name, email, preferences).

responseExample.challenge: Synapse profile update nonce: def456 | ts: 1711234600

agentMeta.note: Step 1 of a profile update. Generates a challenge that proves the owner wallet authorises the change. Required before PUT /auth/me/profile.

outputs.desc: Nonce to sign before submitting profile update

agentMeta.next: Sign the challenge and submit via PUT /api/v1/auth/me/profile

routes.description: Submit wallet-signed proof to update account name, notification preferences, and email binding intent. New or changed email addresses are staged as pendingEmail until a verification code is confirmed. Submitting the current verified email cancels a pending change; submitting null removes the verified email.

bodyExample.message: Synapse profile update nonce: def456 | ts: 1711234600

agentMeta.note: Step 2 of profile update. Submits the signed challenge alongside new profile fields. Wallet signature prevents unauthorised profile changes.
agentMeta.requires: Challenge from POST /auth/me/profile/challenge, signed by owner wallet

routes.description: Confirms the 6-digit code sent to a pending email address. Only after this succeeds does Gateway bind the email to the wallet account.

agentMeta.note: Step 3 of email binding. Submit the code from the verification email. Codes expire after 10 minutes and lock after 5 bad attempts.
agentMeta.requires: PUT /auth/me/profile must have staged a pendingEmail first

errors.message: The code is incorrect or malformed
The code expired; request a new one

routes.description: Generates a fresh 6-digit verification code for the current pending email. Each wallet can send at most 5 verification emails per UTC day.

agentMeta.note: Use when a user did not receive the current code. Resending invalidates the old code.
agentMeta.requires: A matching pendingEmail on the authenticated wallet

errors.message: Daily email verification limit reached

routes.description: Invalidates the current session token server-side.

agentMeta.note: Invalidate the JWT when the session ends. After this call the token cannot be used for any further requests.

groups.title: Balance
groups.description: Account balances, deposits, and spending-limit queries.

routes.description: Returns the complete balance breakdown: consumer available (spendable by agents), provider receivable (earned, unsettled), and protocol fee totals.

agentMeta.note: Check spendable balance before issuing agent credentials. consumer_available_balance is the USDC an agent can spend. If zero the owner must deposit USDC first.

outputs.desc: Spendable USDC — must be > 0 before issuing agent credentials

errors.message: Missing or expired JWT

routes.description: After completing the onchain SynapseCore.deposit() transaction, register the txHash to initiate balance indexing.

agentMeta.note: Call after the onchain USDC deposit is confirmed. The gateway indexes the event and credits consumer_available_balance.
agentMeta.requires: Valid JWT + confirmed onchain deposit transaction

outputs.desc: Deposit intent ID — use in the confirm endpoint

errors.message: This transaction hash has already been registered

routes.description: Returns the current velocity-limit policy for the owner account (daily, per-call).

agentMeta.note: Returns the configured spending velocity limits. Agent credential credit_limit must not exceed these limits.

groups.title: Services
groups.description: Service registration, discovery, listing, updates, and deletion.

routes.description: Returns the marketplace of active, healthy services available for invocation. Supports text search and pagination.

params.name: search_query
params.description: Free-text search over service names and descriptions

agentMeta.note: First step for a consumer agent: scan the marketplace for available APIs or LLM services. Fixed-price APIs return pricing.amount; LLM services return token-metered fields.

outputs.desc: Service identifier for POST /agent/invoke
api uses costUsdc price assertion; llm uses maxCostUsdc or automatic hold

agentMeta.next: For API services pass costUsdc. For LLM services omit costUsdc and optionally pass maxCostUsdc.

routes.description: Returns a paginated, machine-readable registry of services that are currently callable from the public marketplace. Use this when an agent needs to enumerate registered services before choosing a serviceId.

params.name: pageSize
params.description: Results per page. Defaults to 10 and is capped at 100.

params.name: q
params.description: Free-text search over service names, summaries, endpoints, roles, and tags

services.summary: Extract line items and totals from invoices.

agentMeta.note: Public machine-readable marketplace feed. It only returns callable services, so agents can page through the registry before selecting a serviceId and invoking through the gateway.

outputs.desc: Callable service identifier to use with POST /api/v1/agent/invoke
Whether the agent should request the next page

agentMeta.next: Choose a serviceId, issue or reuse an agent credential, then call POST /api/v1/agent/invoke.

routes.description: Provider registers an API service on the Synapse marketplace. The gateway proxies incoming invocations to invoke.targets.

bodyExample.summary: Analyze text sentiment via ML model

agentMeta.note: Provider publishes their API as a paid service. The gateway proxies calls to invoke.targets and handles payment automatically.
agentMeta.requires: Valid JWT from a provider wallet

outputs.desc: Assigned service ID — share with consumers or use to update/delete

errors.message: Missing required fields: serviceName, invoke.targets
agentToolName already exists

routes.description: Returns all services registered by the authenticated provider wallet.

agentMeta.note: List all services the authenticated provider has registered. Use to audit active services or get serviceIds for updates.

routes.description: Update any service field including isActive. To delete a service, first set isActive: false, then call DELETE.

agentMeta.note: Update service config. Critical: to delete a service, first PUT {isActive: false} to deactivate it, then call DELETE. Deleting an active service returns 409.
agentMeta.requires: Valid JWT (provider who owns the service)
agentMeta.next: If deactivating before deletion, call DELETE /services/:id after isActive is false

errors.message: Service is already deleted
No service with this ID owned by caller

routes.description: Permanently archives a service. The service MUST be inactive (isActive: false) before deletion.

agentMeta.note: Soft-archives a service. Guard: service MUST be deactivated (via PUT {isActive: false}) first, or this returns 409 SERVICE_DELETE_ACTIVE_CONFLICT.
agentMeta.requires: Service MUST be deactivated — call PUT /services/:id {isActive: false} first

errors.message: Service is still active — deactivate with PUT {isActive: false} first
No service with this ID owned by caller

routes.description: Returns recent provider health probe history for a service owned by the authenticated provider wallet.

agentMeta.note: Provider-owned health drilldown. Use it to understand why a service is or is not currently callable.
agentMeta.requires: Valid JWT (provider who owns the service)

errors.message: Service not found

groups.title: Provider Operations
groups.description: Provider secrets, earnings, withdrawal tickets, and runtime health evidence.

routes.description: Returns active provider secret keys owned by the authenticated provider wallet. The raw secret is never returned after issuance.

agentMeta.note: Provider control-plane inventory for provider secrets. Use owner/provider JWT, not a consumer agent credential.

routes.description: Issues a provider secret for provider-side automation. The secretKey is returned exactly once and must be stored securely by the provider.

agentMeta.note: Provider onboarding step for controlled provider-side automation. This is not a consumer agent spending credential.

outputs.desc: Provider secret returned once; store securely and never expose in client logs

routes.description: Revokes a provider secret owned by the authenticated provider wallet.

agentMeta.note: Emergency rotation path for provider automation secrets.
agentMeta.requires: Valid JWT (provider wallet who owns the secret)

errors.message: Secret does not belong to current wallet
Secret key not found

routes.description: Returns provider earnings analytics and recent settlement context for the authenticated provider wallet.

agentMeta.note: Provider revenue read model. Use it to confirm that paid traffic is producing receivables before withdrawal.

routes.description: Reports whether the gateway can currently issue EIP-712 provider withdrawal tickets.

agentMeta.note: Call before enabling a provider withdrawal button. If ticket signing is unavailable, do not let the user start a withdrawal.

routes.description: Locks provider receivables and creates a provider withdrawal ticket or manual-review request. Amounts must be strings at the API boundary.

agentMeta.note: Provider self-service withdrawal. It never spends consumer balances; it only reserves provider receivable funds.
agentMeta.requires: Valid JWT + X-Idempotency-Key + provider receivable balance

outputs.desc: Withdrawal intent ID used for completion after the onchain withdraw transaction succeeds

errors.message: Provider receivable balance is too low
Gateway cannot verify vault liquidity

routes.description: Returns provider withdrawal intents and their lifecycle statuses.

agentMeta.note: Provider audit view for withdrawal intents. Stale active tickets may be lazily cancelled and released when this endpoint is read.

routes.description: Closes a provider withdrawal intent after the provider's onchain withdraw transaction succeeds.

agentMeta.note: Finalizes the provider withdrawal after chain success. Replays are rejected or idempotently resolved by txHash binding.
agentMeta.requires: Valid JWT (provider wallet) + successful onchain withdraw txHash

errors.message: txHash must be a valid 32-byte hex string
Provider withdrawal intent not found
txHash is already bound to another withdrawal

routes.description: Invoke a service in one HTTP call. For fixed-price APIs, pass costUsdc — the price the agent saw in discovery. For serviceKind=llm / priceModel=token_metered, omit costUsdc and optionally pass maxCostUsdc; Gateway pre-authorizes, captures final Provider usage, and releases the rest.

agentMeta.note: Preferred invoke path. Fixed APIs use costUsdc price assertion. LLM services use token-metered pre-authorization and final usage billing.

outputs.desc: Settlement receipt ID
Actual USDC deducted. For LLM, this is computed from final usage.
LLM token usage when Provider returns a valid final usage object
Hold, captured charge, released amount, provider revenue, and platform fee metadata
Proxied provider API response

agentMeta.next: On PRICE_MISMATCH (fixed APIs): re-call discover() and retry. On LLM usage/streaming errors, do not retry as a charged call until the Provider returns final usage.

errors.message: Service price changed since discovery — re-discover and retry
Streaming LLM requests are not supported in Synapse V1
Provider returned text/event-stream; final usage is required
Provider succeeded without final usage; hold released and no charge captured
Provider usage object is malformed or unsafe
Explicit maxCostUsdc is below estimated worst-case hold
Automatic hold exceeds service cap; pass maxCostUsdc explicitly
Credential budget does not allow this invocation
Service is not active
Idempotency key reused with different payload
Provider service returned an error

routes.description: Fetch the settlement receipt for a specific invocation.

agentMeta.note: Retrieve the settlement receipt for any past invocation. Use to verify completion, audit charges, or retrieve the result if the original response was lost.

errors.message: No invocation found with this ID

routes.description: Owner-level audit log of all invocations under this wallet. Paginated.

agentMeta.note: Owner-level audit view of all invocations under this wallet. Use to reconcile charges, monitor agent activity, and verify settlement amounts.

groups.title: Credentials
groups.description: Issue, list, and revoke agent credentials.

routes.description: Mint a new spend-limited agent credential. The returned token is used by the agent runtime for all /agent/* calls.

agentMeta.note: Owner mints a spend-limited token for an autonomous agent. maxCalls and creditLimit prevent runaway spending. Pass the token to the agent — never expose the owner JWT to the agent.

outputs.desc: Agent token (agt_xxx) — send as X-Credential for agent runtime calls
Credential ID — use to revoke this token later

agentMeta.next: Pass token to agent runtime. Agent calls POST /agent/discovery/search then POST /agent/invoke with costUsdc

errors.message: Owner has no spendable balance — deposit USDC first
credit_limit exceeds owner spending policy

routes.description: Returns all active agent credentials issued by the authenticated owner.

agentMeta.note: Audit which agent tokens are active and how many calls each has consumed. Identify credentials approaching limits.

routes.description: Immediately invalidates an agent credential. Any subsequent call using this token is rejected.

agentMeta.note: Emergency shutoff: revoke a compromised or over-limit agent token immediately. Takes effect server-side instantly.
agentMeta.requires: Valid JWT (owner who issued the credential)

errors.message: No credential with this ID
